about: 회계1 · 회계2 원본 재기(2026-10-21 21시 원본 실측 — plans/회계1.md '원본 재기 필요(묶음 23 · 26)' · 회계2.md 묶음 31): 계좌리스트 [기타 ☑수정일자순(정렬)] · 이체정보 은행명 코드도움(003 → 기업은행) · 재무상태표 [당기누계](비교 머리 = 기준) · [전표발생계정](계정만 · 합계) · 월별손익분석 [기초,당기,기말표시] · 채권감소등록 [입금보고서작성] 전표 묶음기준 거래처별/계정별(QA1G1 10,000 + QA1G2 20,000 → 한 줄 30,000 · '채권 QA1G1 외') → 저장 → 감소 둘 · 입금보고서를 채권조회에서 지우면 채권조회로 돌아옴. 수금형태 어음: 계정코드 받을어음 · 생성방식 직접입력(처음) → 어음번호입력(번호생성 · 만기일자) → 입금보고서 돈 들어온 계좌 = 받을어음 · 추가정보 '채권 …, 받을어음 …' → 저장 → 받을어음조회 증가 둘(거래유형 입금보고서 · 회계전표 같음) → 입금보고서 삭제 → 어음 · 감소 사라짐.

shots.name: 계좌리스트 — 수정일자순 · 이체정보 은행 코드도움
steps: js:(() => { const codes = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map((t) => t.cells[1]?.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean); window.__before = codes().join(','); document.querySelector('input[aria-label="수정일자순(정렬)"]').click(); return window.__before })()

expect:(() => { const now = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map((t) => t.cells[1]?.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean); return now.length > 0 && now.slice().sort().join(',') === window.__before.split(',').sort().join(',') })()
js:(() => { const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')][0]; tr.cells[tr.cells.length - 1].querySelector('a,button').click(); return true })()

shots.name: 재무상태표 — 당기누계 · 전표발생계정
steps: expect:(() => { const ps = [...document.querySelectorAll('p')].filter((p) => /현재$/.test(p.innerText.trim())).map((p) => p.innerText.trim()); return ps.length === 2 && ps[0] === ps[1] })()

expect:(() => { const rs = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map((t) => t.cells[0]?.innerText.trim()); return rs.includes('합계') && rs.includes('(당기순이익)') && !rs.some((x) => /^1\. 자산/.test(x ?? '')) })()

shots.name: 월별손익분석 — 기초,당기,기말표시
steps: js:(() => { window.__n = document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length; [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((l) => l.innerText.includes('기초,당기,기말표시')).querySelector('input').click(); return window.__n })()

expect:(() => { const rs = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map((t) => t.cells[0]?.innerText.trim()); const cogs = rs.some((x) => x === '2. 매출원가'); return !cogs || (rs.includes('기초재고액') && rs.includes('당기매입액') && rs.includes('기말재고액')) })()

shots.name: 채권감소등록 — 거래처별/계정별 한 줄 → 저장 → 채권조회에서 지우면 채권조회
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:Promise.all([window.__api('GET', '/accounts'), window.__api('GET', '/partners')]).then(([a, p]) => { const acc = a.body.find((x) => x.code === '108').id; const pt = p.body.find((x) => x.code); sessionStorage.setItem('gp', pt.name); const s = String(Date.now()).slice(-6); sessionStorage.setItem('g1', 'QA1G1' + s); sessionStorage.setItem('g2', 'QA1G2' + s); return window.__api('POST', '/bonds', { side: 'RECEIVABLE', entryDate: new Date(Date.now() + 9 * 36e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10), direction: 'INCREASE', lines: [{ accountId: acc, partnerId: pt.id, bondNo: sessionStorage.getItem('g1'), amount: 10000, memo: 'QA회계1 묶음' }, { accountId: acc, partnerId: pt.id, bondNo: sessionStorage.getItem('g2'), amount: 20000, memo: 'QA회계1 묶음' }] }) }).then((r) => { sessionStorage.setItem('gInc', r.body.id); return r.status })

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true
js:(() => { for (const k of ['g1', 'g2']) document.querySelector(`input[aria-label="${sessionStorage.getItem(k)} 감소금액"]`).dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('focusin', { bubbles: true })); return true })()

js:(() => { [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((l) => l.innerText.trim() === '거래처별/계정별').querySelector('input').click(); const i = document.querySelector('[role=dialog] input[aria-label="계좌검색"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(i, '현금'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true })()
js:(() => { document.querySelector('[role=dialog] input[aria-label="계좌검색"]').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); return true })()

expect:(() => { const rs = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] tbody tr')].filter((t) => t.cells.length === 10); return rs.length === 1 && rs[0].innerText.includes('30,000') && rs[0].cells[9].innerText.trim() === '채권 ' + sessionStorage.getItem('g1') + ' 외' })()

expect:(async () => { const r = await window.__api('GET', '/bonds?side=RECEIVABLE'); const dec = r.body.filter((e) => e.direction === 'DECREASE' && e.lines.some((l) => [sessionStorage.getItem('g1'), sessionStorage.getItem('g2')].includes(l.bondNo))); if (dec.length === 0 || !dec[0].journalEntryId) return false; sessionStorage.setItem('gJ', dec[0].journalEntryId); const j = (await window.__api('GET', '/journals/' + dec[0].journalEntryId)).body; return dec.flatMap((e) => e.lines).length === 2 && j.lines.filter((l) => l.accountCode === '108').length === 1 && Number(j.lines.find((l) => l.accountCode === '108').credit) === 30000 })()
js:(() => { history.pushState(null, '', '/accounting/bonds/ar'); dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')); return true })()

js:(() => { const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.innerText.includes(sessionStorage.getItem('g1')) && t.innerText.includes('감소')); tr.cells[tr.cells.length - 1].querySelector('button,a').click(); return tr.cells[tr.cells.length - 1].innerText })()

expect:(async () => (await window.__api('GET', '/bonds?side=RECEIVABLE')).body.filter((e) => e.direction === 'DECREASE' && e.lines.some((l) => l.bondNo === sessionStorage.getItem('g1'))).length === 0)()

js:window.__api('GET', '/bonds?side=RECEIVABLE').then((r) => window.__api('POST', '/bonds/delete', { ids: r.body.filter((e) => e.lines.some((l) => l.bondNo.startsWith('QA1G'))).map((e) => e.id) })).then((r) => r.status)

expect:(async () => { const r = await window.__api('GET', '/notes?all=true'); const ns = (r.body.notes ?? r.body.rows ?? r.body).filter((n) => n.noteNo === sessionStorage.getItem('nn1')); if (ns.length !== 1 || ns[0].issueVia !== 'VOUCHER' || !ns[0].issueJournalEntryId) return false; sessionStorage.setItem('nJ', ns[0].issueJournalEntryId); const j = (await window.__api('GET', '/journals/' + ns[0].issueJournalEntryId)).body; return Number(j.lines.find((l) => l.accountCode === '110').debit) === 30000 && Number(j.lines.filter((l) => l.accountCode === '108').reduce((t, l) => t + Number(l.credit), 0)) === 30000 })()
